title: Ceebug's Rounded Hotbar
description: This Project Makes Ur Hotbar Be Rounded. Because It Looks Better
body: This Is A Pack That Makes Your Hotbar Have Rounded Corners On All Slots, It Also Makes The Hotbar Selector rounded. It Looks Like this: ![The Hotbar](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bbcfbac1db0265649ef01ccc462e5aa274135973.png) Looks Much Better Than The Square Hotbar, Next To The Offhand (Which **_is_** Rounded) ### Check out my other resource pack!
